name: AI generation tool exploration for game engine development

mentions.name: AI generation tool exploration for game engine development
mentions.description: A home project evaluating AI generation tools beyond ChatGPT and Claude — including music, sound effects, video generation, and motion generation — with the goal of working with a game engine.
mentions.problem: Frontier AI models still handle non-voice sound (songs, sound effects) and motion understanding (e.g., moving a character) poorly.
mentions.source_excerpt: at home, with the goal of working with a game engine, I'm trying out various tools besides ChatGPT and Claude, like music, sound effect, video generation and motion generation
